topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impacts link budget calculations by increasing the total noise figure (NF) and reducing the carrier-to-noise power density ratio (c/n0), thereby degrading link quality. This requires higher transmit power, increasing interference and power consumption. To mitigate, designers can optimize antenna design for higher efficiency, reducing thermal noise and enabling more demanding modulation schemes. However, this may limit gain and increase size, impacting overall system capacity and performance.
